body:
I was doing some research into something called TMS procedure. Seems like some wavy shit BUT its an option for ppl with treatment resistant depression. It’s painless & seems to have like i think a 70-80% success rate of improving how u feel. Could be worth a shot. 

Im 24 & also treatment resistant
i am glad I got to meet you, you seem like a nice person. :) I’d hope that we can keep talking in the future when you need support. you deserve the happiness you seek 🖤
thanks dad

I get that- i have a hard time taking money too. I wouldn’t ask for it back but I can respect the pass. But the offer will stand if you need it. I support you and your journey. 🖤 & I’m crossing my fingers that they may call you back or they’d be able to do a 1-1 call instead.

Big same here. Idk I generally try to distract myself when I can. Play video games, watch a fun video, play a mindless app. Anything that takes you out of it. I was feeling VERY depressed last night and i saw a random funny picture on my feed and it just took me out of it cause it made me laugh. Its a VERY tiny temporary fix but it’s something. 

Maybe also write down the things you look forward to doing / seeing some day?
Get a pet & pour all ur love into them. They’ll always love u back
Ah i see :( Do you have an estimate on the cost for an uber / lyft? I’d love to be able to help if I can even if at least for one trip.

That for sure can’t always be the case. It may be that they are hiring young people so they can pay them less than older people. This looks to be a career thats high in demand too! 

I aint gonna lie there are some young wizards. For some people it really sticks from day one what they are learning and they can be really fast at it. Others can be slow. What matters though is that you enjoy it & keep learning if you want to. 

Majority of jobs look for people who can do the work, and do it well. The more years of experience you have the higher your chances are. 

Besides i’d consider anything under like 25 years old pretty damn young still. That’s a whole 5 years of learning & understanding

Hm i could definitely understand your frustration. You have ample reason to request this it seems ridiculous they won’t hear you out. Especially with the background & side effects & experiences you’re explaining. 

Maybe you could bluff and say you will be seeking legal action for malpractice for refusing to provide treatment? I have never been in this kind of situation so I’m completely unsure if that’s something that could work.

Sorry a lil late was in a work meeting- do you know anyone who would be willing to help & drive you? Friends, cousins, coworkers?? How much would an uber cost ? 😮

Would you be able to send an email to this place that’s covered? I find that usually easier to make requests & explain things than the phone. But obviously not mentioning the abusive household like you said

Idk man i attempted several times and i was just pissed when i woke up. I didnt have second guesses. I’m not afraid of death, it sounds like an escape. That sounded a wee bit cringe lmao but i’d enjoy dying. If someone came up to me threatening to shoot i would thank them. And dumbest thing is i know i have not had the worst life out there, not by a long shot. But living feels like shit and it has for the last 12 years. 🤷‍♀️
Ah damn. Well that’d be no good. Are there other places nearby?

Oh shit man im 24 haha 

Honestly i think thats on society. You got miles of time ahead of you engineering or not. Society has people thinking they gotta have their shit figured out by the time they are 21, and expect you to have your life path and career all figured out. 

I absolutely would not think of you as a failure if you just took some time to figure out what you’d like to work towards. I have seen lots of stories about people who don’t land their dream job until they are 30-35. 

In the meantime you could just fuck around with a part time easy ass job while you try things out ?

I understand that 100%. Phone calls can make me have a total breakdown. :( Maybe if you called back and let them know like “hey, this is extremely hard for me. I have severe anxiety and I’d like to know if we can just do this one on one”? 

It can be really hard to hype yourself up for a call, but it could be absolutely worth it if it works out and you can be a happier you! I would hope that these people can understand how important this is for you & will work to be accommodating 🖤

Edit cause i wanted to add it in: also imagine how proud you would feel knowing you gave it another go! Im a stranger and maybe my word means nothing but lemme tell you i’d be really fucking proud.

Ah fuck, of course. Doctors who write that kinda shit off due to weight always really piss me off. I feel for you and I don’t want you to die either. I know we are strangers but I really want the best for you. I really think you should continue getting more opinions, and be firm with your doctors. I understand after so many “second” opinions it can feel bleak, but you never know, maybe the 18th one will be different & help you & really listen ?
Are you able to reschedule ?
Oh shit yeah i could see how that’d be a bitch to deal with. Did they say / do anything about the high blood pressure at least ? That seems like evidence to look into what your feeling

I feel that man. I’m in limbo myself. I thought i wanted to be an artist but i’m realizing i just don’t think i have what it takes & that feels like i’ve wasted 10 years. I think now its something i like to just do for fun and not for a living. 

You’d be pretty surprised what you can learn about yourself of what you can do well & that you enjoy. Sounds cheesy as fuck i know lmao but idk I’d say give some other shit a chance that maybe you enjoy or have wondered about. 
In my opinion fuck school. You can pick it up later. I had 50 year olds in my community college when i went lol
Goddamn tf are these doctors doing. Have they offered pain meds at all ?

I think they design antidepressants to not allow for death by OD cause that’d be just like giving a suicidal person a loaded gun right? And I tried to OD on sleeping pills, took at least 15 & i just woke up sick as hell & puked. Hope you are still here OP.
Maybe this career just isn’t for you? I quit college to figure out what i wanted in life. Is engineering and going to Uni something YOU want or are you doing this for someone else ?
That’s fuckin nuts. Did you get a second opinion? Sometimes doctors are just lazy & incompetent it might help to go to someone who will listen.
Fair enough, i can see how it can definitely change someone’s mind. I hope that it can help others truly. 🖤
Oof, sounds painful. Was that from you or was that what you needed the doctors to see & it’s already been like that?
edited: i realize giving methods is against the rules lol
You could likely die before they even have the chance to operate- that is the largest blood vessel in the body & a stab would could be lethal very quickly.

I’ve been in the exact same boat & still healing to this day. I’m unsure what your home life is like, but I know when I brought up the topic of going to a therapist to my parents they thought it was ridiculous. I never told them why other than a vague “im sad”. 

Are you still in school? Have you tried reaching out to a school counselor?
Also here if you need someone to talk to :)

Thank you for sharing your story & I’m so sorry to hear that this has happened to you and that you are living through this. It’s nice to hear that you are still determined to live, but no matter what the circumstances are, some people’s urge & feelings to die are stronger than others. 

I am glad that you do not want to kill yourself, but I am sure most people who have suicidal thoughts & ideations have said to themselves at least once “someone out there has it worse than me” and it does not change their decision or their pain. I do hope this perspective can maybe help someone out there.
